$comment: The compression dial (docs/PLAN.md C3, S0-03). Web and Mac load this file; neither hard-codes a level. Order = dial order, longest first. Labels come from spec/strings/en.json by label_key. Prompts are complete user messages with a {{text}} placeholder (reduce: {{lines}}); the runtime sends them through the model's chat template with thinking off.

levels.description: Every sentence, in order, read aloud. No model. Always one key away.
2 to 5 bullets of at most 9 words. Register: plain words, one idea per line, answer first.
One line for the whole document. More than one chunk: per-chunk lines, then reduce. Only the final line is spoken.
